WITH region_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count,
    COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client) as share
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM region_counts
),
above_avg_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    client_count,
    share
  FROM region_counts
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(client_count) as total_clients_above_avg,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_of_above_avg_regions,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc) as avg_distance_above_avg
FROM above_avg_regions
